svg.title: Video between AVPlumber instances: libfabric between hosts, CUDA IPC on one GPU
svg.desc: Between hosts, fabric_sink sends intra-coded frames over libfabric TCP to fabric_source. H.264 intra from NVENC and JPEG from nvJPEG, decoded on NVDEC; HEVC intra (the default, 8 or 10-bit, 4:2:0 or 4:4:4, lossy or bit-exact), JPEG 2000 through nvJPEG2000, ProRes 4444 on the CPU with alpha inside the stream. Alpha for HEVC travels as a second key stream with the same PTS, encoded on NVENC and decoded on NVDEC like the fill. At matched quality for 8-bit 4:4:4, HEVC intra needs 140 KiB per frame, H.264 intra 204, JPEG 2000 224 and JPEG 282. Bit-exact 8-bit 4:4:4: JPEG 2000 970 KiB at 60 fps, HTJ2K 1,102 at 577 fps, HEVC intra 1,358 at 152 fps, H.264 intra 1,453 at 255 fps but NVDEC cannot decode it. On one GPU, CUDA IPC shares the frame allocation between containers.
